body:
P2-25 DESIGN, part 4: the one rule N-34 and every repair call, survives_fold_whole (docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md, part 4; the lead relayed the advisor ruling: the skip rule is "the name survives the fold WHOLE", NOT "the key is empty").

textnorm.survives_fold_whole(text) = "this name can be compared by key without losing what tells it apart from another name": it holds at least one letter or digit, and the fold keeps a word character for every letter, digit and kept mark of it that the table does not remove ON PURPOSE (decorating marks, the tatweel, format characters; a letter may become two, the sharp s is ss; none may become none by accident). The tatweel row (an Arabic name with it: era 0 false, era 1 TRUE) is in the fixture. It guards against a WRONG match (a wrong stamp, a wrong move), not against a miss: a curly apostrophe survives and still gets another key than a straight one until slice 2 (a duplicate, never a wrong answer).

ERA 0 (until P2-25 slice 2 merges; what N-34 slices 1 to 3 call): decided against the CURRENT ASCII fold: after NFKD every letter and digit that is not a combining mark is ASCII. ERA 1 (from slice 2): decided against the new fold, so true for every text with a letter or a digit; the guards at the call sites then never fire. Each guard is marked STOP-GAP(P2-25 skip-rule) and is removed one release after slice 3; a guard test fails when a marked guard names a release that has passed. The function itself stays: it is also the selector of the repair.

ONE FUNCTION, DEFINED ONCE, in textnorm.py by the first PR that needs it (N-34 slice 1 or P2-25 slice 1) together with the shared fixture rows (section survives, columns era0 and era1); the second PR imports it. Nobody copies the rule: N-34 refile carries its own TEST ROW, not its own copy. It is called on every string the caller then compares by key: the lead artist, the title, and the album when the album is compared.

RUN, era 0 (the rows of the test): TRUE for Bjork (o with diaeresis), Beyonce, Sigur Ros, a Vietnamese name with stacked marks, Istanbul (dotted capital I), the Swedish A with ring, U with diaeresis, a Czech name with caron, BTS, Ke$ha, fullwidth Latin letters, circled digits, a title with a curly apostrophe. FALSE for fully non-Latin names (Arabic, Cyrillic, Japanese, Korean); FALSE for MIXED titles (Habibi plus an Arabic word; a Cyrillic word plus a Latin one); FALSE for EXTENDED LATIN: Polish l-stroke (also inside a full Polish phrase), Turkish dotless i (while s-cedilla and g-breve pass), German sharp s, Icelandic eth and thorn, Scandinavian o-slash and ae (while a-ring passes), Serbian and Vietnamese d-stroke.

TWO SIBLINGS, not for N-34 slices: refs.key_is_degenerate(key) (a segment of the stored key is empty: the cheap sign of damage) and refs.recheck_pending(conn, ref_id) (the ref is on the P2-25 worklist, table ref_recheck, from slice 3). REFILE AND EVERY REPAIR THAT MOVES A FILE MUST REFUSE A REF THAT IS ON THE WORKLIST: its files may belong to other songs, and the rehome of slice 4 judges them first. Until slice 3 exists no ref is on a worklist, so N-34 slice 5 hard-needs P2-25 as the design of PR #96 already says.
